args.title: Fix error toast announcements and visibility
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Change the aria-live attribute from 'polite' to 'assertive' for error toasts to ensure they are announced immediately by screen readers.
Additionally, modify the AUTO_DISMISS_MS logic to keep error toasts visible until manually dismissed, improving accessibility for users who need more time to see the message.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The error toasts are using 'aria-live="polite"' which causes delays in announcements. They are also dismissed automatically after five seconds. The code in 'src/components/Toast.tsx' should be updated to make error toasts use an assertive live region and remain visible until dismissed.
